remarks: The space your family needs, with the style you'll love! Welcome to the Kayzlee by Alquinn Homes, offering 2,142 sq. ft. of thoughtfully designed living space and the sought-after FOUR-BEDROOM option! This beautifully designed two-storey home features a stunning open-to-above great room, 9' ceilings, and an abundance of natural light. The open-concept main floor is perfect for entertaining, with a chef-inspired kitchen featuring a quartz island and walk-through pantry, plus a dedicated den and functional mudroom. Upstairs, discover four spacious bedrooms, a versatile loft and study area, convenient upper-floor laundry, and a private primary retreat complete with a spa-inspired ensuite and oversized walk-in closet. With 9' basement ceilings and future development potential complete with a separate entrance, this home offers the perfect blend of style, space, and functionality for growing families. Discover the Kayzlee & make Westerra your next home! (id:67522)
